speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in before the bar, and you have a face on you. Sit. Dinner is threepence if you eat it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat it. I was an old man of the house this afternoon, and I was off before the end.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Off before the end is a mercy. Did they make you the lover?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. An old man. Not the lover. The lover can finish his own afternoon.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: An old man who may sit down is a fortunate old man. The loom does not let a man leave in the middle of a yard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a finger and a half short of the notch, and the price is a penny. I am not measuring it for your play. Eat the short end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and a finger and a half. I have had the measure all month. I am not asking for a new one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is ink on the finger still. Is that the king's, or the afternoon's?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The king's is dry. I did not open him today. The letter is the one I did not write.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Which letter? You have a house full of unwritten things, and only one of them pays board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Susanna's. She is still eleven. The twenty-sixth is Monday. The thimble is on the road. The letter is not written.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A letter that waits for its day is a decent letter. A letter that hurries is how a man says the wrong age.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Eleven is a serious age. I was serious at eleven, and nobody wrote me a letter either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then nobody will write one at my table tonight. Threepence, the short end, and bed at a Christian hour. Mark me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can keep the hour. I cannot send a letter I have not begun.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Begin it on its morning. Monday has room, if Monday is the day you named.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday is her day. Tonight is the bowl.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the horn down if you are done with black. There was a thumb of it this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the horn. There is enough for a name, and a name is all I wrote.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A name is not a letter, and a letter is not my business until it wants a seal. Eat.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will eat. An old man of a house, off before the end, and a letter left for Monday. That is a tidy Friday.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Tidy is the step swept. I swept it. I am not sweeping a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sweep nothing of mine. I am done. Threepence, Mistress, and the short end, and the letter where I left it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Monday for the letter, then. I can remember a day if someone else has named it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Where you left it is nowhere, which is cheap. Good. The house is quiet after nine.
